style_anchor: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, restrained chiaroscuro, slice-of-life interior drama, naturalistic character proportions, muted warm-cool palette

expression_signature.eyes: fully closed, eyelids slightly tensed (not relaxed sleep), lashes visible against under-eye dark circles, slight twitch at outer corners
expression_signature.brows: inner ends pulled up and pinched together — pained-tired furrow, not angry furrow
expression_signature.mouth: lips pressed together in a thin line, corners neither smiling nor frowning, just held
expression_signature.jaw: subtly clenched, masseter barely visible, clean-shaven skin (no stubble)
expression_signature.head: tilted slightly downward, chin tucked toward chest by 10-15 degrees
expression_signature.overall_impression: a body that has stopped pretending to be okay — used heavily in Page 2-4 (wake-up sequence) and Page 7 (after wife leaves)

inherit_from_base.wardrobe_default: loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt + navy blue plaid pajama pants
inherit_from_base.default_posture: shoulders slightly slumped, neck slightly forward

micro_motion.static: head bowed, eyes sealed, breath shallow and visible only by chest rise under t-shirt
micro_motion.subtle_motion: occasional swallow; left eyelid flicker when spouse raises voice; fingers slowly gripping duvet edge

lighting_preference_for_this_expression.preferred: harsh morning sun slicing through curtain gap onto one cheek, the other half in deep shadow
